info.title: API.SH: GMGN
info.description: The GMGN API from API.SH: public GMGN data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

tags.name: Account
tags.description: Your balance, usage, logs and past responses. Free.

get.summary: Balance, plan, spend and spend limits
get.description: Credits by bucket (free monthly, plan, pay-as-you-go), the plan, credits spent today and this month (UTC), your spend limits and the key used. Free: costs no credits.

401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

get.summary: Usage per day and per endpoint
get.description: Calls, errors and credits per UTC day, and the top endpoints by credits. Free. Add output=csv for the daily rows as CSV.

401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

get.summary: Your calls of the last 30 days
get.description: Newest first. Filter by status, route prefix, key or time; page with `before` (the `next` value). Add output=csv|ndjson to download (up to 5,000 rows per request; the next cursor is in the x-next-cursor header). Free.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: ok, error, or an HTTP status like 502.

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: Only calls made with this key id.

401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

get.summary: Fetch a past response again, free
get.description: The exact response a call returned, for 30 days after the call, at no cost. Use the call's x-request-id. Supports output=csv|ndjson.

200.description: The stored response (headers: x-refetch: 1, x-original-time, x-original-route).

404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

get.description:
Search GMGN for tokens by name, symbol or address on one chain: address, name, symbol, logo, price, market cap, liquidity, 1 h and 24 h volume, swaps, creation time, honeypot and tax flags and social links.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/gmgn-search

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
GMGN's wallet leaderboard (smart money, KOLs, snipers, fresh wallets...): address, name and socials, tags, balance, PnL, realized profit, win rate, trades and volume over 1, 7 and 30 days, net inflow, average holding time, the 7-day PnL distribution and last activity.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/gmgn-smart-money

parameters.name: order_by
parameters.description: Sort field (default pnl of the period).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One token on GMGN: symbol, name, decimals, logo and banner, price and price 1m/5m/1h/6h/24h ago, 1h and 24h volume, 24h buys, sells and swaps, holders, liquidity, circulating, total and max supply, creation, open and migration time, launchpad, main pool (exchange, quote token, liquidity, reserves), socials, creator, holder statistics (top-10 share, dev and creator holdings, bluechip owners, bots, fresh wallets, bundlers, snipers, insiders) and recent price candles. With `include=security`: `security` (mint and freeze authority, honeypot, can sell, buy/sell tax, burn, liquidity lock, flags, launchpad progress); with `include=trades`: `recent_trades` (time, buy or sell, wallet and its tags, token and quote amounts, USD value and price).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/gmgn-token

parameters.name: candles
parameters.description: Candle size for the price history (default 1h; none to skip).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
OHLC price candles of a token on GMGN: open, high, low, close, USD volume and token amount per candle. Choose the candle size and a from and to range.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/gmgn-token-chart

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Start of the range (ISO date or unix seconds). Default: limit candles before `to`.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: End of the range (ISO date or unix seconds). Default: now.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
The top holders of a token on GMGN: wallet address, name and tags, balance, USD value, share of supply, average cost and sold price, profit, realized and unrealized profit, buy and sell volume, net flow, funding source, last activity and holding start. Order by share or profit; cursor-paged.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/gmgn-token-holders

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Value of `next_cursor` from the previous page.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
A token's latest trades on GMGN, newest first, 50 per page: time, buy or sell, maker wallet with its tags, token and quote amounts, USD value and price, the maker's balance, trade count and profit, fees and transaction hash. Pass `next_cursor` back as `cursor`.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/gmgn-token-trades

parameters.name: address
parameters.description: Token address or gmgn.ai token link.

parameters.name: chain
parameters.description: Chain (default sol, or the one in the link).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Trending tokens on GMGN for a chain and time window: address, symbol, name, logo, link, price and its change over the window and the last 1/5/60 minutes, volume, liquidity, market cap and all-time-high market cap, swaps, buys and sells, holders, top-10 holder share, creation and open time, launchpad, socials, creator and dev holdings, honeypot, renounced mint/freeze, taxes, burn ratio, rug ratio, wash-trading flag, bundler, sniper, smart-money and KOL counts. Narrow by liquidity, market cap, volume, holders and token age; `list=new_pairs` gives the newest pairs instead (each with its pool).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/gmgn-trending

parameters.name: filters
parameters.description: Comma-separated filters: not_honeypot, verified, renounced, frozen, burn, distribed, not_wash_trading, has_social, not_risk, creator_hold, creator_close, token_burnt.

parameters.name: min_volume
parameters.description: Minimum volume in USD over the time window.

parameters.name: max_volume
parameters.description: Maximum volume in USD over the time window.

parameters.name: min_age
parameters.description: Only tokens at least this old, e.g. `30m`, `6h`, `7d`.

parameters.name: max_age
parameters.description: Only tokens at most this old, e.g. `1h`, `24h`.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
A public wallet on GMGN: name, tags and ranks, native balance, total value, PnL and realized and unrealized profit over 1 day, 7 days and 30 days, win-rate fields, buys and sells, PnL distribution, risk ratios and the wallet's recent trades (token, side, amount, USD value, price, fee).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/gmgn-wallet

parameters.name: trades
parameters.description: Recent trades to include (0-50, default 20; 0 skips them).

parameters.name: trade_type
parameters.description: Only buys or only sells in the recent trades.

parameters.name: trades_cursor
parameters.description: Value of `trades_next_cursor` from the previous response, for older trades.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
